business_scope.primary_industry_name: Polyresin Vacuum Casting and Hand-Painted Limited Edition Statues

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and Indigenous Customary Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force 13 December 2020
No bilateral income tax treaty or bilateral investment treaty in force; Vanuatu applies a territorial tax system and does not tax International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2014 (Act No. 27 of 2014, Cap. 231), as amended by the AML/CFT (Amendment) Act 2017 and AML/CFT (Amendment) Act 2018; International Companies Act 1994 (Cap. 222), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2017; Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2017; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (Operations) Regulations 2015; VFSC AML/CFT Supervisory Manual issued under the Financial Services Commission Act 2017.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or Commissioner for Oaths in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Republic of Vanuatu High Commission/Consulate or honorary consul) — Hague Apostille is not accepted as Vanuatu is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banker's reference letter confirming identity and financial standing of each UBO or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in origin country followed by Consular Legalization where required by the VFSC-licensed registered agent's AML/KYC policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency for any corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or registered agent of the entity's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path (if home jurisdiction is not an Apostille state) or certified extraction accepted by the Vanuatu registered agent under its AML/KYC procedures

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address of each UBO (utility bill, bank statement, or tax letter dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or tax authority in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization where the document will be relied upon by a Vanuatu public authority; otherwise notarized copy accepted by the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter for proposed directors (required by registered agent policy for offshore directors)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified accountant, lawyer, or corporate services provider in the director's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Consular Legalization if the director declines an in-person AML interview with the Vanuatu registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and shareholders against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN/SSI lists, UK and EU consolidated sanctions lists, Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) domestic designations, Interpol notices, and PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence (source of funds and source of wealth) is triggered for any PEP, family member, or close associate of a PEP, and for any person resident in a jurisdiction on the FATF grey or black list. Screening is performed by the VFSC-licensed registered agent before incorporation and refreshed annually or upon a material change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registrar — International Companies name reservation; online name search and clearance portal at https://www.vufsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must use the Latin (Roman) alphabet; English and French are official languages and Bislama is the national language, so no statutory transliteration into a local script is required. Non-Latin script names must be accompanied by a certified transliteration into Latin characters. Every International Company name must end with the word 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd'. Names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, reserve, or registered business name and must not mislead as to activity or government connection.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank (and derivatives such as Banking, Banker) — requires VFSC banking license
Trust, Trustee — requires VFSC license or consent
Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance — requires VFSC license
Fund, Mutual Fund, Investment Fund — requires VFSC license
Building Society, Chamber of Commerce, Cooperative — requires registration
University, Polytechnic, College, Institute — requires Ministry of Education consent
Stock Exchange, Commodity Exchange — requires VFSC license
Government, Commonwealth, National, State, Republic, Crown — implies official connection and requires ministerial consent
Vanuatu, Vanuatu National — requires VFSC/Government authorization
Any token implying United Nations, Commonwealth Secretariat, or royal patronage
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name clearance is requested via a licensed registered agent. If the 30-day reservation is not used, a fresh application and fee are required. On rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration request to the VFSC Registration and Licensing Committee within 21 days of the rejection notice, attaching the rejection letter and alternative names; the Committee determines the application within 14 business days. A further rejection may be challenged by way of judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu, or a new name with revised wording may be resubmitted. Rejected words are often approved where a written no-objection consent from the relevant regulator (e.g., Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for 'Bank') is filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a Vanuatu International Company: the IC must at all times maintain a registered office in Vanuatu and a VFSC-licensed registered agent. The agent's physical office serves as the statutory registered office; no physical commercial premises, employees, or local business presence in Vanuatu is required to conduct the resin statue garage-kit e-commerce business. The target payment rails (Stripe/PayPal) do not require local substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% annual probability) for a non-resident, tax-exempt International Company with no VFSC financial services license and no suspected AML/CFT triggers; probability rises to 5–15% if the company applies for a VFSC license, changes its registered agent repeatedly, or appears on a sanctions/PEP alert.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992 (Act No. 14 of 1992, as amended), ss 4 (incorporation), 5 (memorandum of association), 6 (articles of association), 31 (registered office), and 43-53 (officers and directors).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Private Mail Bag 12023, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a Vanuatu International Company. The first subscriber must take at least one share; no escrow account or paid-in deposit is required under VFSC practice.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, as at [date], by the sole subscriber and first director of [Company Name] Limited: 1. The subscription for one ordinary share of no par value is accepted, and such share is allotted to the subscriber as shareholder. 2. The registered office of the company is established at the office of the licensed registered agent, [Agent], Port Vila, Vanuatu, and [Agent] is appointed as registered agent. 3. [Name] is appointed as director and [Name] as secretary of the company, each to hold office in accordance with the International Companies Act 1992. 4. The director and secretary are jointly and severally authorized to execute all applications, filings, banking forms, and contractual documents required to give effect to this resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage a licensed registered agent and obtain name clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu. Instruct the agent to search the proposed company name for availability against the VFSC International Companies Registry. The agent submits the name clearance request and reserves the approved name pending full incorporation.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of the beneficial owner
Corporate KYC and constitutive documents if the shareholder is a company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or objected to, resubmit an alternative name or file a written appeal with VFSC within 14 days; the first resubmission does not attract an additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and execute Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association to comply with the International Companies Act 1992. The subscriber executes the documents and takes at least one share. Execution is notarized or attested as required by the registered agent’s policy.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the constitutional documents, amend the defective clauses and re-execute the documents with the agent; refile within 7 days of the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit incorporation application and pay state fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the registered agent consent, and the name clearance slip. Pay the prescribed government registration fee. VFSC processes the application and verifies compliance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any deficiencies identified by VFSC and resubmit within 7 days. A first correction is generally processed without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and establish statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and the International Company comes into existence. The registered agent opens the company's statutory minute book and registers the certificate, constitution, and share records.
required_dossiers: Minute book and statutory register templates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains any typographical error, request a corrected certified copy from VFSC through the registered agent; VFSC issues the corrected certificate without substantive re-review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm registered office, registered agent, and first officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the registered office is situated at the registered agent's address in Port Vila. Appoint the first director and the company secretary through a written resolution of the subscriber. File any required notice of directors and officers with VFSC, if applicable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing is late or rejected, submit a statutory declaration explaining the omission and pay the applicable late filing fee through the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt first board resolution and open banking and payment accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company board and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first board resolution approves the share allotment, the registered office, and the officer appointments. The company then applies for any bank or payment service provider accounts, such as Stripe or PayPal, using the Certificate of Incorporation and constitutional documents. A corporate bank account or third-party processor account is established for preorder deposits and customer payments.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the payment processor requests evidence of a physical trading location, provide a detailed place-of-business declaration and, where relevant, a trading licence or warehouse proof from the jurisdiction where the resin casting actually occurs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None for a Vanuatu International Company acting exclusively as an offshore trading and export entity; an IC cannot obtain a local industrial operating licence. If onshore production premises in Vanuatu are later established, the company must convert to or register as a Vanuatu local company and obtain approvals from the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and the relevant municipal Business Licence Office.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No local operating licence is required for the International Company's offshore activities. Contingency only: a Business Licence under the Vanuatu Business Licence Act 2019 would be required if physical polyresin casting and painting operations are based in Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not applicable for the offshore International Company. If physical resin statue casting occurs on Vanuatu territory, the operation would be screened under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act Cap 283; small-scale craft resin casting would likely be classified as EIA Registration, while industrial-scale polymer manufacturing with solvent emissions would require a full EIA Report.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: N/A to the offshore IC. Contraindication for local production: no untreated wastewater containing uncured resin, mould-release solvents, or acetone may enter municipal sewers; implement zero-liquid-discharge or pre-treatment to Vanuatu Board of Standards limits; control VOC emissions with local exhaust ventilation and maintain workplace VOC concentration below 50 ppm or as prescribed by Vanuatu occupational health regulations; dispose of hazardous resin waste through an approved contractor with a waste manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for the offshore International Company. If onshore garage production is later established: obtain a fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Section (VFRS), complete a structural load inspection for vacuum pumps, moulds, and curing equipment, and register the workplace under the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2006 before operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Department (VRCD), under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; online filing portal: VRCD Tax Administration System (TAS) at https://tas.vanuatu.gov.vu; corporate registry and International Company licensing counterpart: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://www.vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, Registered Agent's consent letter, and registered office details. 2) If the IC will make taxable supplies inside Vanuatu exceeding VT 10 million, submit the VAT Registration Form (VRCD VAT-01) via the TAS portal together with the certified Certificate of Incorporation, Registered Agent letter, registered office address, director and shareholder particulars, and a statement of intended activities (ISIC 3240 polyresin statue manufacturing). 3) VRCD issues the VAT registration number within approximately 10 business days of complete lodgment. 4) For an IC deriving no Vanuatu-source taxable turnover, no TIN/VAT ID is legally required; the IC may nevertheless apply to VRCD for a written tax-exemption status letter confirming the zero-tax regime. 5) Register as an exporter with Vanuatu Customs (ASYCUDA World) to obtain an importer/exporter code required for export declarations of resin statue garage kits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Pure territorial/exemption model. An International Company is statutorily treated as a non-resident tax-exempt entity: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax, and no stamp duty under the International Companies Act. Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax on any entity. The IC is exposed only to indirect taxation: 12.5% VAT applies solely to taxable supplies made within Vanuatu above the registration threshold; export sales of polyresin statue garage kits to non-resident customers are zero-rated and outside the domestic taxable base.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no US-style check-the-box election; IC tax-exempt status is statutory and automatic. Available elections include: (1) election in the Articles of Association to be limited by shares or by guarantee; (2) voluntary VAT registration under the VAT Act 2022 even below the VT 10 million threshold to recover input VAT on export production inputs; (3) election to maintain non-resident status for VAT zero-rating purposes; and (4) no hybrid mismatch election exists because Vanuatu has not adopted OECD BEPS Action 2 rules. All elections are documented through the Registered Agent and filed with VFSC/VRCD as applicable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT), imposed by the Value Added Tax Act No. 3 of 2022, in force 1 July 2023, administered by VRCD; import duty levied separately under the Customs Act on imported raw materials (resin, silicone, pigments).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 (approximately USD 84,000) gross taxable turnover in any rolling 12-month period, or as soon as the person has reasonable grounds to expect the threshold will be exceeded; separate non-resident supplier registration applies to foreign suppliers of electronic/digital services to consumers in Vanuatu.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping mandate is currently operative in Vanuatu. Registered suppliers must issue VAT tax invoices containing the statutory particulars (supplier name and VAT registration number, invoice date, description of goods, taxable value, VAT amount) and retain invoices digitally for 7 years. VAT returns are filed electronically through the TAS portal on a monthly basis, with quarterly filing permitted for qualifying small taxpayers. Export clearances are processed through the ASYCUDA World customs system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods (including polyresin statue garage kits) are zero-rated under the VAT Act where: (i) the goods are exported by the supplier within 30 days of the invoice date or within a VRCD-approved extended period; (ii) the goods are consigned to a destination outside Vanuatu; and (iii) documentary proof of physical export is obtained and retained. Offshore services supplied to non-resident customers (e.g., custom sculpture design, licensing of artwork, and remote assembly instructions) are zero-rated where the benefit is enjoyed outside Vanuatu. Preorder deposits collected via Stripe or PayPal for goods subsequently exported qualify as zero-rated export supplies provided each payment record is matched to the corresponding export shipping documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged through ASYCUDA World) showing HS/ISIC-aligned commodity description of resin statue kits
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
VAT return with export schedule (VRCD supplementary export listing) identifying each zero-rated shipment
Preorder and payment rail records from Stripe/PayPal matching the export invoice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCD may audit export zero-rating claims with a minimum assessment window of 3 years, extended up to 7 years where fraud is alleged, and may compel production of bank, payment-rail (Stripe/PayPal), and customs records. Penalties for false zero-rating or forged export documentation include: (i) civil assessment of the VAT evaded at 12.5% plus a monetary penalty of up to double the tax shortfall and monthly default interest; (ii) criminal prosecution with fines up to VT 5,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 7 years; (iii) retrospective clawback of all input VAT credits claimed on production inputs (resin, pigment, mold materials) attributable to the disqualified export supplies; (iv) reclassification of the supply as taxable at 12.5% with backdated effect; and (v) referral to VFSC for deregistration of the International Company for conduct inconsistent with the tax-exempt regime. Where Vanuatu law imposes no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline, the 180-day benchmark is retained here as the documentary and anti-money-laundering prudential standard applied by VFSC-authorized banks and export credit counterparties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), Port Vila, the statutory central bank, monetary authority and exchange-control administrator under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125] and the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 69]; the RBV licenses and supervises all commercial banks in Vanuatu and designates authorized dealers for foreign-exchange conversion, while the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registers and supervises the International Company (VU_IC); money-laundering and terrorism-financing examinations are conducted jointly through the RBV and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit under the AML/CFT Act No. 18 of 2016.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is a managed-basket currency without deep international trading depth; Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, therefore current-account payments and profit remittances are not subject to exchange restrictions, but the RBV retains permission-based control over specified capital-account transactions. For the non-resident International Company (VU_IC), convertibility is effectively unrestricted: the International Companies Act No. 33 of 2022 deems the IC non-resident for exchange-control purposes and exempts it from RBV exchange-control permissions, enabling free retention and disbursement of USD, EUR and AUD accounts, unrestricted export pricing, and full profit/dividend distribution to non-resident shareholders without any Vanuatu withholdings, corporate income tax, capital gains tax or stamp duty.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporting traders, the statutory baseline under RBV exchange-control practice is that export proceeds must be repatriated to Vanuatu through an authorized dealer and converted into VUV within 180 days of shipment where directed by RBV notice. The VU_IC is statutorily deemed non-resident, so no mandatory repatriation deadline, no surrender ratio and no conversion requirement applies to its USD/EUR pre-order and settlement proceeds for polyresin statue garage kits; the only binding duties are (i) retention of a documentary export spine (sales order, invoice, packing list, dispatch proof) and (ii) routing of any incidental USD-to-VUV conversion exclusively through an RBV-authorized dealer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.notional_note: This supplementary note is not part of the schema-mandated fields but is retained for drafting continuity only.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for the initial equity injection and a segregated USD/VUV Operational Account for export settlements
Operational multi-currency account (USD/VUV) with a dedicated Stripe/PayPal settlement sub-ledger
Domestic VUV/USD Operational Account limited to registered-office, agent and utility expense payments

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: LOW to CONDITIONAL. Vanuatu has no dedicated Electronic Money Institution licensing regime, and the AML/CFT Act No. 18 of 2016 together with RBV banking supervision requires any entity carrying on payment or money-transmission business in/into Vanuatu to hold a banking or authorized-dealer licence. Consequently, offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, Stripe Treasury) generally refuse onboarding of VU-domiciled International Companies, and local banks will not clear VUV through unlicensed EMI accounts. Workable architecture: PayPal and Stripe merchant accounts remain feasible only as inbound pre-order collection rails, with payouts auto-swept directly into the VU_IC's ANZ or BSP USD account; the EMI must never function as the primary settlement bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Initial onboarding requires physical in-branch attendance at the Port Vila (or Luganville) office of ANZ or BSP by at least one natural-person director, accompanied by the Vanuatu-licensed International Company agent, or an RBV-accepted on-site compliance visit where remote opening is requested; no pure e-KYC/digital-only onboarding exists for a zero-tax non-resident IC. The opening pack must contain original passports, notarized Certificate of Incorporation, VFSC register extract, Certificate of Good Standing, registered-agent declaration, beneficial-ownership register, board resolution, CRS/FATCA tax self-certification, bank reference letters and evidence of commercial substance (supplier and customer contracts for the ISIC 3240 trade).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Automatic enhanced due diligence (EDD) triggered by the IC's zero-tax offshore classification and the VFSC registry's non-resident director/shareholder structure, raising tax-evasion, shell-company and criminal-enrichment red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Good Standing; certified register of directors, shareholders and beneficial owners; board resolution authorizing the banking relationship; CRS/FATCA tax self-certification; shareholder bank reference letter; recent management accounts evidencing real turnover from resin-statue sales; executed purchase and sales contracts proving tangible economic activity; written declaration that the IC is an operating trading vehicle, not an asset-protection shell.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent inbound settlements from PayPal/Stripe card acquirers categorized as card-not-present, cross-border, high-volume micro-deposits, triggering concern over unexplained third-party batching, unlinked receivables and e-commerce money-laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed merchant agreements with PayPal and Stripe; monthly platform settlement statements; matched pre-order ledger showing buyer name, email, invoice ID, item value and dispatch status; end-customer invoice copies; logistics evidence (tracking numbers, bills of lading, courier manifests); live e-commerce storefront displaying the ISIC 3240 polyresin statue product line; monthly reconciliation of platform payouts to expected gross sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large SWIFT out-payments to Guangdong/Hong Kong manufacturing counterparties for PU resin raw materials, mould-making and hand-painting subcontracting, triggering counterparty-jurisdiction and trade-based money-laundering reviews.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully addressed supplier proforma invoices and purchase orders naming each casting workshop; corporate registry extracts or UBO declarations for each supplier; goods-inspection certificates (SGS or Bureau Veritas) for shipments above USD 25,000; China Customs export declarations and bills of lading evidencing physical trade flow; signed production, quality-control and intellectual-property agreements between the VU_IC and each manufacturer; payment-beneficiary match against the registered counterparty name.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The shareholder effects the equity injection by SWIFT MT103 from an onshore bank (Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia or USA) to the VU_IC's ANZ or BSP capital-escrow account in Port Vila, cleared through the bank's New York/Sydney correspondent network; the wire narrative (Field 70) must read 'Share capital injection under International Companies Act 2022 - subscription for ordinary shares' and must avoid ambiguous wording such as 'investment', 'loan', 'gift' or 'family transfer'. The verification dossier comprises a certified copy of the share register, board resolution approving the allotment, receipt confirmation of the VFSC annual return, and a source-of-wealth/net-worth questionnaire executed by the injecting shareholder. Where the IC subsequently funds a controlled overseas manufacturer by way of intra-group advance, the payment purpose code must be re-characterized as intercompany loan and evidenced by a written shareholder-loan agreement carrying commercial interest.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for raw-material and casting-workshop payments: SWIFT MT103 in USD from the VU_IC's BSP/ANZ operational account, with full supplier remittance advice, purchase-order reference and trade-description in Field 70, funded by daily pre-sweep of the Stripe/PayPal settlement sub-account to eliminate unexplained float balances. Secondary rail for production series exceeding USD 25,000: irrevocable sight or 60-day usance commercial letter of credit opened through ANZ/BSP by SWIFT MT700 against supplier bill of lading, commercial invoice and inspection certificate. USD clearing is correspondent-based (New York and Hong Kong nostro accounts) because no domestic USD clearing grid exists in Vanuatu; every outbound disbursement is released only after the compliance officer matches invoice value, ISIC 3240 product description and shipment evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV deliverable forward contracts (3-12 months) with ANZ or BSP treasury desks, fully collateralized by export receivables and board-approved for coverage of local agent and office costs
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on USD/VUV booked through the same banking group's London or Singapore FX desk, cash-settled in USD because VUV forward liquidity is thin
USD/AUD and USD/VUV cross-currency swaps limited to funding Vanuatu registered-office, licensed-agent and professional fees (infrequent and board-approved only)

Natural treasury hedge: denominating all sales, receivables, payables and platform settlements in USD while holding minimum VUV balances, rendering residual exchange exposure immaterial; listed FX options on VUV are not available from local banks

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee Renewal (no annual return or financial statement filing applies to a Vanuatu International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - submitted through the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each annual incorporation anniversary; VFSC renewal cycle includes a 30-day administrative grace period before the late-payment surcharge accrues
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 20% of the annual government fee; persistent non-payment or loss of registered agent triggers administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act [CAP 222], followed by asset vesting and a costly VFSC restoration procedure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Annual Attestation and Register Status Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC central Beneficial Ownership Register (data maintained and attested by the licensed Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Delivered with the annual license fee renewal on each incorporation anniversary; interim UBO changes must be reported within 14 days of the relevant transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal offence under the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework - fines up to VUV 5,000,000 on the company, daily default penalties on directors, and regulatory review supporting administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None - a Vanuatu International Company is exempt from statutory audit unless it holds a regulated VFSC licence (banking, insurance, trust or securities business) under sectoral acts; a low-risk polyresin statue trading company with no Vanuatu taxable activity has no audit trigger.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies Act [CAP 222] requires only records sufficient to explain transactions and financial position; no IFRS or Local GAAP mandate applies - IFRS is recommended as best practice for the cross-border resin statue e-commerce operations with Stripe and PayPal settlement rails.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual attestation of current beneficial owners accompanies the license fee renewal on each incorporation anniversary; share transfers affecting beneficial ownership must be recorded in the UBO register within 14 days, and any nominee or trust arrangement must be disclosed to the Registered Agent with supporting documentation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Register (held and updated by the Registered Agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$650 - US$1,250 per annum (licensed Registered Agent service, registered office address, UBO register maintenance and annual VFSC filing)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Voluntary audit only (not legally required): US$3,500 - US$7,000 for a low-transaction-volume resin statue sales entity with Stripe/PayPal settlement records

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no national corporate income tax on any company, and International Companies are expressly exempt from all Vanuatu income and profits taxes (s. 47(1) of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, dividend distribution tax, stamp duty and business licence tax for the entire life of the International Company; the only recurrent charges are the VFSC registration fee and the annual government fee scaled to authorised share capital, plus licensed agent professional fees. No Vanuatu VAT (12.5%) arises on exported resin statue garage kits because the compliant IC undertakes no supply in Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ICA s. 125 Annual Return / VFSC Company Confirmation — filed by the licensed registered agent through the VFSC eServices Business Registry portal (eservices.vfsc.vu). No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu because no CIT is imposed.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 3 months after each incorporation anniversary; the annual government fee is payable on the anniversary date itself. There is no CIT return deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered name, former names and registration number of the International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact name as shown on the certificate of incorporation; no Vanuatu tax identifier is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of incorporation and anniversary date
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the VFSC-issued date; confirm the anniversary with the agent to avoid the late-filing window.
Must be the physical address of the licensed registered agent; a PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, licence number and certification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent certifies the return; non-resident founders never file directly with VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and alternate directors: full names, nationalities and residential addresses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide certified passports and utility bills; non-citizen residential data is held confidentially by the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders and issued share capital: authorised vs issued capital, classes of shares and bearer share status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List non-resident shareholders; confirm no bearer shares subsist if Stripe/PayPal settlement is used.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt-status declaration confirming no Vanuatu domestic business was conducted (s. 6 ICA)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any sale was made to Vanuatu residents, the declaration is false and the exemption is void; restructure before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee computation and payment receipt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fee schedule is based on authorised capital; pay by bank wire through the agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fee of VUV 5,000 per company; continued default triggers administrative strike-off under the Companies Act. Restoration requires a VFSC order, payment of all arrears and penalties that can aggregate to approximately VUV 100,000; directors of a struck-off company are exposed to disqualification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: DCIR VAT Return (Value Added Tax Act 2017, monthly filing through the DCIR online portal) — not applicable to a compliant International Company that conducts no domestic supply in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VAT returns are due by the 15th day after the end of each calendar month for registered persons; a pure offshore IC has no obligation to register or file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies made in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Leave nil unless the IC has unlawfully sold resin kits to Vanuatu consumers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of imports of resin and moulding materials cleared for home consumption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC importing goods for export may apply to DCIR for customs duty and VAT relief; no domestic clearance should occur.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input VAT claimed on allowable purchases
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only a registered domestic taxpayer may claim; an IC is not registrable while compliant.
Nil for a compliant exempt IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: VAT Act 2017 imposes penalties of up to 200% of evaded tax plus daily default interest; domestic trading also triggers the s. 6 ICA prohibition and VFSC strike-off proceedings.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no dividend withholding tax and no deemed-dividend rules exist in Vanuatu; s. 47(1)(d) ICA exempts all distributions made by an International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive network of double taxation agreements, so no domestic DTA claim is required: the statutory rate on dividends is already zero. For shareholders requiring proof of exemption for foreign tax credit purposes, instruct the registered agent to apply to the Department of Customs & Inland Revenue for a Vanuatu tax status / exemption certificate by submitting (i) the ICA certificate of incorporation, (ii) a VFSC good-standing letter, (iii) the latest annual return, and (iv) a notarised declaration of no domestic business; issuance typically takes 5 to 10 working days.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and 0% treaty rate on royalties and interest paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents; Vanuatu imposes no outbound withholding tax on IP licensing or debt interest. However, because Vanuatu has no broad income tax treaty network, the payor jurisdiction customarily withholds 10% to 30% on royalties and interest flowing into Vanuatu; a commercial gross-up clause and a manufacturing-services contract are preferable to a pure Vanuatu royalty conduit.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and no transfer pricing legislation, hence no Local File or Master File threshold is prescribed locally. As prudent foreign-audit practice, when related-party inventory flows in the non-resident supply chain exceed USD 2,000,000 per annum, the group should maintain OECD-compliant documentation in the consumer market country to prevent profit recharacterisation; no VUV-denominated statutory threshold exists.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu currently imposes no Economic Substance Regulations filing regime comparable to BVI or Cayman, but the VFSC annual confirmation requires an exempt-status declaration and a beneficial ownership disclosure. Genuine substance must still be demonstrable: board meetings and minutes in Port Vila, an exclusive licensed registered agent, and the physical polyresin vacuum-casting, painting and shipping operations held in the foreign production site. A mailbox-only IC will trigger BEPS Action 7 permanent establishment and CFC recharacterisation in the consumer jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing pre-order deposits from Stripe and PayPal into a Vanuatu IC bank account while the entity exercises no real management or commercial substance and while claiming that the absence of Vanuatu corporate income tax eliminates worldwide taxation of resin statue profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu Revenue Administration Act 2017: penalties up to 200% of evaded VAT or import duty where any domestic element exists, criminal prosecution for fraudulent exemption use, and VFSC strike-off; foreign jurisdictions additionally recharacterise income under GAAR and CFC rules and impose their own penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution of mischaracterised profits, VFSC director-disqualification orders, travel bans during active investigations under the Vanuatu Immigration Act, and Penal Code fraud terms of up to 12 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Business (s. 6 International Companies Act)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling resin statue garage kits to Vanuatu residents, leasing Port Vila warehouse space, hiring local staff, or maintaining local inventory without converting the International Company into a Vanuatu domestic company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine on conviction of up to VUV 1,000,000 per offence under the ICA, immediate forfeiture of exempt status, forced deregistration, and recovery of unpaid VAT at 12.5% plus late-payment penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorise domestic trading are jointly and severally liable for the company's fines and VAT; non-citizen directors may be subjected to removal and travel-restriction procedures pending settlement, and imprisonment applies for contempt of VFSC orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining bearer or nominee share structures with undisclosed beneficial owners while accepting recurring Stripe or PayPal pre-orders and failing to report suspicious transactions to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML and CFT Act 2011 (as amended): fines up to VUV 2,000,000, freezing and forfeiture of settlement accounts, Stripe and PayPal merchant termination, and VFSC refusal to accept the annual return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who receive or authorise laundering of customer deposits are personally liable for restitution, subject to travel bans pending FIU investigation, and to money-laundering imprisonment of up to 10 years under the Vanuatu Penal Code.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Marketing the Vanuatu IC as treaty-protected to customers worldwide and issuing invoices that purport to eliminate source-country withholding tax on royalties, commissions or distribution fees absent any applicable double tax agreement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Source-country penalties reach 30% to 40% of the grossed-up payments plus default interest; aggravated criminal-fraud sanctions apply and refunds to customers may be ordered; a Vanuatu exemption certificate does not cure foreign withholding obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who endorse false withholding or preferential-rate certifications face disgorgement of fees, civil restitution to affected licensees, travel restrictions imposed through mutual legal assistance, and imprisonment for foreign tax fraud in the consumer state.
